digest.component_or_area: jira data center reconciler, live integration harness
propositions: A DC issue created in the harness does not appear in the local store after an inbound pass, or a local ticket edit does not appear on the DC issue after an outbound pass, defeating the epic's headline acceptance criterion.
The store copy is empty or incomplete, preventing realistic volume testing of the reconciler against production ticket shapes, link graphs, and field histories.
The reconciler configuration in the isolated working repo points to production Cloud Jira instead of the harness, risking unintended writes to real issues.
The copied store retains production Jira bindings and snapshots, causing the reconciler to form intents to write to real production issue keys despite physical isolation of the repo.

Mutation round-trips fail or are unasserted individually, leaving defects in specific directions (inbound link, outbound status transition, identity minting) hidden under aggregate 'converged' verdicts.
